episode_summary: In this episode, Chris Linsell discusses the importance of building a personal brand independent of brokerage identity, especially in light of recent real estate mergers. He emphasizes the need for agents to create content that AI can cite, focusing on answering specific questions to increase visibility. The conversation also covers the potential impact of industry consolidation on agents and the opportunities for independent brokerages.
